definitions.explanation: A high-altitude cloud made of small white ripples or grains arranged in regular patterns. Popularly called うろこ{雲|ぐも} (scale clouds) or さば{雲|ぐも} (mackerel clouds), and associated with a 'mackerel sky'.

examples.japanese: {空|そら}に{巻積雲|けんせきうん}が{浮|う}かぶ。
examples.english: Cirrocumulus clouds float in the sky.

examples.japanese: {巻積雲|けんせきうん}が{出|で}ると{天気|てんき}が{変|か}わりやすい。
examples.english: When cirrocumulus clouds appear, the weather tends to change.

examples.japanese: {秋|あき}の{空|そら}に{広|ひろ}がる{巻積雲|けんせきうん}は、まるで{魚|さかな}のうろこのようだった。
examples.english: The cirrocumulus clouds spreading across the autumn sky looked just like fish scales.

notes:
A high cloud of the {巻雲|けんうん} (cirrus) family, made of tiny white masses. Forming far higher than {高積雲|こうせきうん}, it is a classic sign of autumn skies and approaching weather change.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- うろこ{雲|ぐも}: scale clouds — everyday nickname for {巻積雲|けんせきうん}
- さば{雲|ぐも}: mackerel clouds — another common nickname

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {高積雲|こうせきうん}: altocumulus — similar ripples but lower and coarser
- {巻雲|けんうん}: cirrus — wispy high clouds of the same family
